title: SQLite 4.0 released with a new storage engine
summary: The SQLite project has shipped version 4.0, which replaces its long-standing storage layer with a log-structured engine. Maintainers say write throughput improves substantially while the file format stays readable by older tools.

title: A deep dive into how modern CPUs predict branches
summary: An engineer walks through the techniques current processors use to guess which way a branch will go, from simple counters to neural-style predictors. The piece explains why mispredictions are costly and how code layout can reduce them.

title: Ask HN: What are you using for personal backups?
summary: The poster asks readers which tools they trust for personal backups. Replies compare snapshot-based tools, cloud storage and offline drives, with many stressing the need to test restores regularly.
